title: Statifier conformance manifest
description: conformance/manifest.json, the index a sibling implementation reads first: the corpus hash a claim is pinned to, one entry per corpus file, and the upstream suites the SCION and W3C cases were taken from. Generated by the emitter and never edited by hand (ADR-0070).

corpus_hash.description: sha256:<hex> over the corpus files' content, in suite order. A registry pins its claims to this value.

suites.description: One entry per corpus file, in suite order - scion, w3c, statifier, the order corpus_hash concatenates the files in - skipping a suite with no file.

file.description: The corpus file, as a path relative to conformance/.

case_count.description: The number of cases in the file. Never zero: a suite with no cases has no file.

upstreams.description: The upstream suites SCION and W3C cases were taken from, one entry per suite, sorted by suite.

url.description: Where the upstream suite is published.

revision.description: The upstream commit the documents were read at, where the upstream has one.

notice.description: The licence text and copyright notice, as a path relative to conformance/.
